subject: HIGHEST-ALGEBRAIC function
notes: §15.43.4 r2's own NOTE table, all seven rows in order, including the three the corpus never held: S9(4) BINARY -> +9999 (the PICTURE) against BINARY-CHAR SIGNED/UNSIGNED -> +127/+255 (the picture-less container). ⚠ The two BINARY-CHAR lines are a DETERMINATION pin, not a standard-fixed value: §13.18.60.4 GR21 makes a BINARY-CHAR item's representation and length implementor-defined and GR12 states only minimum ranges ('The implementor may allow a wider range', §A.1 item 206 = optional), which is what the NOTE's '(assuming an 8-bit representation)' flags — they measure docs/CONFORMANCE.md A.1 items 206/207 (1 byte, minimum range, signed and unsigned the same width) and move only if those move. The five PICTURE'd rows are fixed by r2 plus the picture character-string.
